body:
Founder real-time: LO upstream and design doc added - check it over, needs to compile into Java/TS/C/Go via parena/burrow CLIs. Real, critical review (not rubber-stamped): no formal grammar exists, emoji-tokenization ambiguity unaddressed, loops/error-handling explicitly unfinished in the source material, a real code-size-blowup risk in the spec's own let-lowering scheme. Real architectural correction: LO/qi should emit real .prn text only, reusing parena/burrow entirely, not building new backends. Real capability audit: parena (mature, defstruct/defenum/match/loop/Vec/FFI) can reach most of LO; burrow (scalar+flat-struct only) can only reach a narrow LO subset -- same boundary stdlib/k8s/k8s.prn vs scaling.prn already drew. Real, phased plan in NORTHSTAR.md. No compiler code yet. LO commit 008c6f8.

⚓ ☃
title: Real critical review of LoLanguageSpec.pdf, NORTHSTAR scoping pass
